sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def pos(frame,ch):
    aa=frame.ascii.splitlines()
    p=[(r,c) for r in range(21,36) for c in range(12,52) if aa[r][c]==ch]
    if not p: return None
    return (min(x[0] for x in p)//3-7, min(x[1] for x in p)//3-4)
seq=[('UP',(2,0),(2,8)),('RIGHT',(2,2),(2,8)),('RIGHT',(2,4),(2,8)),
     ('DOWN',(4,4),(2,8)),('RIGHT',(4,6),(2,8)),('RIGHT',(4,8),(2,8)),
     ('UP',None,None)]  # last: the test, expect unknown
for i,(act,ep,er) in enumerate(seq):
    r=action([act])
    res=r if isinstance(r,dict) else {}
    done=res.get('done') or res.get('game_over') or res.get('level_completed')
    p=pos(current_frame,'b'); rd=pos(current_frame,'R')
    print(i,act,"player:",p,"red:",rd,"done:",done)
    if done: print("DONE/ANOMALY"); break
    if i<6 and (p!=ep or rd!=er): print("ANOMALY - stopping"); break
    if i==6:
        print("TEST RESULT: player at",p,"red at",rd)
        if p==(2,8) and rd==(2,6):
            print("SWAP WORKED - continuing to goal")
            for act2 in ['RIGHT','RIGHT','UP','UP']:
                r2=action([act2]); res2=r2 if isinstance(r2,dict) else {}
                d2=res2.get('done') or res2.get('game_over') or res2.get('level_completed')
                p2=pos(current_frame,'b'); rd2=pos(current_frame,'R')
                print("cont",act2,"player:",p2,"red:",rd2,"done:",d2)
                if d2: print("FINAL DONE"); break
        break
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
